Interest Rules

1.Introduction to earnings: The amount deposited in the interest treasure must satisfy at least one complete cycle to generate interest. If it is transferred out in advance, no earnings will be calculated in that period. For example: the current settlement period is 1 hours, then the amount transferred by 01/01/2026 00:00:01 will generate interest in the first period in 01/01/2026 01:00:01;
2.Settlement cycle: The current interest settlement cycle is 1 hours;
3.Annual interest rate: The current annual interest rate is 200%;
4.Calculation formula: Interest earnings = deposit amount * annual percentage rate / settlement cycle;
5.Example:A deposits 01/01/2026 00:00:01 in 10,000, the annual interest rate is 200%, and the settlement period is 1 hours, then the first interest income is obtained in 01/01/2026 01:00:01. The calculation method is as follows:First interest = 10,000*200%/365 days/24 hours*1 hours = 2.283105;
6.Transfer threshold: Each transfer amount must be greater than or equal to 100 (i.e. ≥100). There is no upper limit for the transfer amount. The more the transfer, the greater the income;
7.Interest interest cap: There is no cap on the current interest rate. Remember to collect your income regularly or frequently to avoid missing out on more income;
8.Claim time: It is currently collected in real time, that is, it can be collected as long as interest accrues;
9.Audit Multiplier: The interest bonus granted in this activity requires 1 times the valid bet amount for withdrawal. Betting in No specific valid platforms, only the received interest is subject to the audit requirement; the transferred principal (in/out) has no audit requirements.
10.Event Statement: This function is limited to the account owner for normal game betting. Account leasing, risk-free betting (including betting, wagering, and low-loss betting), malicious arbitrage, use of plug-ins, robots, exploiting protocols, vulnerabilities, interfaces,Group control or other technical means are prohibited. Once verified, the platform reserves the right to terminate member logins, suspend member website usage, and confiscate bonuses and improper profits without prior notice;
11.Disclaimer: When members receive the interest reward, the platform will assume that the member agrees to and complies with the corresponding conditions and relevant regulations. To avoid misunderstandings due to textual interpretation, the platform reserves the right to make the final explanation of this event.
